scripts.dev: bun run --filter @treetino/contracts build && bun run --parallel --filter '@treetino/*' dev
scripts.dev:frontend: bun run --filter @treetino/contracts build && bun run --filter @treetino/frontend dev
scripts.dev:backend: bun run --filter @treetino/contracts build && bun run --filter @treetino/backend dev
scripts.build:frontend: bun run --filter @treetino/contracts build && bun run --filter @treetino/frontend build
scripts.build:backend: bun run --filter @treetino/contracts build && bun run --filter @treetino/backend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @treetino/contracts build && bun run --filter '@treetino/*' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build:backend && bun run --filter @treetino/backend test && bun run --filter @treetino/frontend test
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend backend packages scripts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend backend packages scripts package.json tsconfig.json
